title: When a client approves an estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Here's what changes in the CRM when a client approves an estimate.

steps.caption: Tick Approved
steps.narration: On Estimates, tick Approved to see the ones your clients have accepted.

steps.caption: Approved by, signed contract
steps.narration: The banner names who approved it. The estimate is now a signed contract.

steps.selector: text=It can no longer be edited or deleted.
steps.caption: Locked
steps.narration: It can no longer be edited or deleted.

steps.caption: Sent and opened
steps.narration: You still see when it was sent and when the client opened it.

steps.caption: The client's page
steps.narration: Click the client's name to go to their page.

steps.caption: Approved, by whom, when
steps.narration: Under Estimates, the estimate shows who approved it, and when.

steps.caption: Project: Approved
steps.narration: Their project has moved to Approved by itself.

steps.caption: Create invoice
steps.narration: When you're ready to bill, Create invoice turns the approved estimate into an invoice.

steps.caption: All clients
steps.chapter: Job Won on the client list

steps.caption: Job Won
steps.narration: the client is now counted under Job Won.

steps.caption: Menu: Estimates
steps.narration: You'll find Estimates in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: What happens when a client approves an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of an approved estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see the approval banner, why a signed estimate is locked, how the project moves to Approved by itself, where Create invoice appears, and the client under Job Won.
